source.commitNote: origin/main at authoring time. Engine feature freeze: no file under Sources, Tests, Package.swift or tools/SceneValidator changed; no vocabulary was added.
source.authoring: Hand-built. A Claude agent (Claude Fable 5.2) wrote the five documents by hand from the briefs in each PROMPT.md. They are not the output of Marty's question-to-lesson loop. Every run of marty-solid check --strict on a candidate file is one counted attempt; attempts.ndjson in each folder holds all of them with the full document text.
source.license: Apache-2.0; procedural geometry, no images, models or stock assets

capture.machine: Apple M1 Mac mini (Macmini9,1), arm64; macOS 27.2
commands: marty-solid check --strict <document>   (once for each counted attempt)
reencode <NEW_DIR>/story.mp4 story.mp4 650000 (AVFoundation; see each artifact's reencode)
PNG to JPEG with ImageIO, quality 0.85 (every still; poster.jpg is a copy of one step still)
capture.oneBuild: Every first-round check, attempt and render used this one engine executable (SHA-256 above). The fact-check fix (factCheckFix) used a second release build of the same engine source, built in another build directory, with a different executable SHA-256; it made the last attempt of each document and the fact-fix render. Files that the fact-fix render did not replace come from the first render.
capture.notInTheRepository: The scratch tools (the attempt recorder, the frame and re-encode tool, the landing-gear angle calculation) and the engine's full-size PNG and MP4 files.
capture.buildCheck: The golden test of Examples/Solid3D runs a debug build. The author compared the debug and the release report of every published document: they are the same except the engine identity. The landing gear needed attempt 10 for this (GAPS.md, gap 13).

review.facts: docs/assets/drone-aviation/FACTS.md lists every claim with its source and what the engine checked. Two independent fact checks (Sol and Gemini) read it on 2026-11-11: no claim failed, and all fixes are applied (see factCheckFix).
review.builderInspection: The author viewed every step still of the first accepted render of each document and a set of story frames (hold frames and frames inside camera moves). Findings and fixes are in each PROMPT.md attempt list. The author also read the exported quadcopter mesh to confirm that all eight propeller blades lead with their raised edge.
